package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	cli "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/cli/diagnosticbinding"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticbinding"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		_ = cli.WriteFailure(os.Stderr, failureReason(err))
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	input, err := cli.ParseEnvironment(os.Getenv)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, input.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if err := pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, err := diagnosticbinding.Provision(ctx, postgres.Store{Pool: pool}, input.CourseID, input.CreatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	output, err := cli.NewOutput(result)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return cli.WriteOutput(os.Stdout, output)
}

func failureReason(err error) string {
	if errors.Is(err, cli.ErrInvalidInput) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		return "invalid_input"
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) {
		return "binding_conflict"
	}
	return "database_unavailable"
}
